tasks.build: deno task build:clean && deno task build:bundle && deno task build:icons && deno task build:static
tasks.build:bundle: deno bundle --platform browser --minify --outdir dist src/background.ts src/content.ts src/injected.ts src/popup.ts
tasks.build:icons: rsvg-convert -w 16 -h 16 src/icons/icon.svg -o dist/icons/icon16.png && rsvg-convert -w 48 -h 48 src/icons/icon.svg -o dist/icons/icon48.png && rsvg-convert -w 128 -h 128 src/icons/icon.svg -o dist/icons/icon128.png
